option_a: spend your life building something that outlasts you but never see it finished
option_b: complete something meaningful in your lifetime that disappears entirely the moment you die
framing: Whether legacy requires your absence or meaning requires your witness.

option_a: be able to fully understand every person you meet but no one can understand you
option_b: be completely understood by everyone, but lose the capacity to understand others
framing: Whether empathy flows outward or inward — and which direction makes a life livable.

option_a: live in a world where every moral question has a correct, knowable answer
option_b: live in a world where morality is genuinely uncertain, but your choices are entirely your own
framing: Whether moral certainty is worth the loss of authentic agency.

option_a: have the power to end all suffering in the world but erase all joy along with it
option_b: preserve the full spectrum of human experience knowing suffering will always exist
framing: Whether the elimination of suffering justifies the elimination of its opposite.

option_a: know the exact moment and manner of your death
option_b: never know when you will die but be guaranteed it will be peaceful
framing: Whether certainty about finitude changes how fully we inhabit the present.

option_a: remember every experience you have ever had with perfect clarity
option_b: forget everything after seven years but live each moment with complete presence
framing: Whether a self requires continuity of memory or fullness of attention.

option_a: live in a just society you had no hand in creating
option_b: build a society from scratch knowing it will be imperfect but yours
framing: Whether justice is something inherited or something made — and which binds more deeply.

option_a: discover that free will is an illusion and all choices are fully determined
option_b: have genuine free will but bear absolute responsibility for every consequence of every choice
framing: Whether freedom is worth the weight of total accountability.

option_a: pursue a truth that destroys everything you currently love
option_b: live inside a beautiful lie that sustains everything you value
framing: Whether truth has intrinsic worth or only instrumental worth — and what that means for a life.

option_a: be remembered forever for something you are not proud of
option_b: be forgotten entirely after living a life you are deeply proud of
framing: Whether legacy is for the living or the dead — and who its audience really is.
